_comment: Steam counters on entry = times boosted this turn -> COUNT_BOOSTS (boost appends one marker per boost). Was {"type":"FLAG_SET"} used as an AMOUNT — a condition type in an amount slot, which resolves to 0. NEEDS_NEW_DSL: the damage-replacement half ('if your hero would be dealt damage, remove that many steam counters instead') needs the incoming damage amount in a replacement context, which no amount expression provides; that ability is removed rather than left silently doing nothing.
